outcome: Trends in post-cesarean delivery analgesia research
cohort: Publications on postoperative pain management of C-section indexed in the Science Citation Index Expanded (SCI-E) of Web of Science (WOS) Core collection database from 1978 to 2022
finding: The study found a marked increase in research on post-cesarean analgesia, with a focus shift towards nerve blocks, postnatal depression, persistent pain, and enhanced recovery.
